notes: Bay Area Reporter, 2 January 1986 to 31 December 1987, 106 weekly issues, read from the Internet Archive's DjVu text (no hOCR). Hand-curated: address clusters and event-word passages were read and each finding's quote checked against the issue. People rule as in the dossier: no owners, managers, staff, performers or patrons.

coverage.remaining: 1988 to 2005 remain: 917 issues in the collection, January 1988 to 28 July 2005.
coverage.note: 106 issues; 13,519 numbered-address mentions on EAS streets, 687 windows after the advertisement filter (329 of them rescued for an event word) in 596 address clusters, of which the 183 holding an event word outside the classified pages were read; plus 660 event-word passages, of which the 31 with a fire, closing, lost-lease or moving word and no out-of-town or review marker were read. 26 findings written, each quote found again in the issue's text; 9 take their number from another issue of the paper. 21 resolved and published on 18 existing pages; no page seeded and none held. 5 unresolved, their numbers no longer joined to one parcel in EAS (48 Belcher, 890 Folsom, 525 Howard, 222 Guerrero, 527 Valencia).
